role: Abstract base of the chat component tree: holds a ChatStyle and sibling components, and composes the flat and formatting-code text forms used to draw chat.
scope_reason: In scope: the base of the chat components whose formatted text (getFormattedText with siblings and styles) GuiNewChat (in scope) draws in the HUD.

members.name: style
members.note: style, a slot of the tree's styles (-1 not made yet)

members.name: getSiblings
members.note: the serializer's extra and the iterator's tail (pw_expand)

members.name: getChatStyle
members.note: made empty on first use, the siblings parented to it

members.name: iterator
members.note: itself then its siblings' iterators, without recursion (a work list)

members.name: getUnformattedText
members.note: feeds only the server console log (MinecraftServer.addChatMessage)

members.name: getFormattedText
members.note: the parts GuiNewChat joins: each iterated component's formatting code and text. Java runs it only where a frame draws the chat (GuiNewChat.func_146230_a, skipped unless the tape's header has "chat": true: Oracle.cleanHudChat); the frame replay of out/java/hudscreens/hudscreens-s1 runs it (lane/covnet, JaCoCo on make replay FRAMES=... EVERY=10) and test_hudscreens judges its lines

members.name: createDeepCopyIterator
members.note: the copies' only use is their deep-copied style, the parent chain resolved

members.name: equals
members.note: the only caller is CombatTracker.func_151521_b's var6.equals(var4) in the fall branch, where var4 is the last (fall) entry's attacker name: CombatEntry.func_151522_h returns null for DamageSource.fall (it has no entity), so `var4 == null ||` short-circuits; ChatComponentTranslation.equals and HoverEvent.equals only recurse from it

members.name: hashCode
members.note: no game path hashes a component

notes: Every S02 the server sends is compared per row: the oracle's rows carry each tick's S02s (Rows.s02: the IChatComponent.Serializer JSON and GuiNewChat's iterated parts) and test_snapshots and play --check compare csrc/engine/chatcomp.c chat_s02_check against the queue (lane/idxchat, DEVLOG 2026-09-27).
